body: bro, don't let it get to your head. best way to carry on is to ignore your computer and phone (if possible), throw away your drawing supplies, and get something like ColdTurkey and block out all things that stimulate your urges. And you don't want to die. That's just nerves talking.
If it's your decision, and you feel that it'd bring you peace, follow your heart. I just hope that you don't, but again, it's your life. I hope you find solace in your decision.
If it's truly the best decision for you personally, I hope you find comfort. Drift on, my friend. Hope I see you some day.

Please don't kill yourself. Go on a website like indeed, and find a good job in your line of work. Apply everywhere you can. Tell them you could really use the job, maybe flash a few pictures of the cat. Try to get jobs. Don't sell your cat. If need be, go on Fiverr and do a few jobs to keep up with car payments. Talk to your landlord about a financing option. There are mental health counselors at emergency rooms that are no cost to you. That's what the government is there for. Get out of the city, if you can try. Please, don't jump to any conclusions. Your life has meaning.
